blocks.text: The module defines workspace privacy, role hierarchy, joint ownership, voting, and attribution rules in its module documentation. It then imports database, chat, and audit helpers and declares the fixed stage sequence.
blocks.title: Workspace model and stage primitives

blocks.text: _next_stage supplies the sequence successor, while promote validates access and updates primary or active stages. active_stages_precheck reports expected ineligibility without mutating state.
blocks.title: Complete and partial promotion

blocks.anchor: def auto_partial_promote(ws_id: str, to_stage: str) -> dict | None:
blocks.text: Automatic promotion bypasses human access checks and attributes changes to a system actor. The chat-triggered path reuses promote for real permission enforcement and sends a session notification after success.
blocks.title: Automatic and chat-triggered tabs

blocks.text: Database rows become stable workspace dictionaries, chat aggregation uses deterministic creation ordering, and role helpers centralize access checks. Chat synchronization groups links by owner before bulk updates.
blocks.title: Row shaping and access helpers

blocks.text: CRUD functions list, fetch, create, rename, attach, create, detach, and delete workspaces or chats. Mutating paths update timestamps, write audit events, and resynchronize linked chats.
blocks.title: Workspace and chat lifecycle

blocks.text: Internal notification lookup is intentionally auth-free, while roster reads require membership. Add, role-change, and removal operations enforce moderator or partner boundaries and return normalized member data.
blocks.title: Membership administration

blocks.anchor: def remove_owner(ws_id: str, partner_id: str) -> dict:
blocks.text: Partners can force the owner into joint state, owners can leave or name a partner successor, and non-owners remove themselves. In joint state, partner votes are recorded and a strict majority immediately elects an owner.
blocks.title: Owner transitions and voting

blocks.text: Owner and partner can toggle attribution directly, while moderators need an explicit grant. can_see_attribution returns visibility for privileged roles or consults the workspace flag for viewer/editor roles.
blocks.title: Attribution controls

blocks.text: Exports are scoped to the requesting user's chats even when a workspace contains collaborators. Imports restore new chats owned by the caller and attach them to the selected workspace.
blocks.title: Workspace backup and restore

gotchas: Private chats owned by other users are omitted from workspace chat_ids.
Partial promotion is forward-only except that note is explicitly allowed as an automatic target.
Deleting a workspace detaches every chat row before deleting the workspace.
Owner and partner have equal operational rank, but only owner occupies the owner_id slot.

purpose: This service owns workspace lifecycle, chat attachment, membership permissions, owner transitions, voting, attribution visibility, and backup/restore. It keeps workspace chat links synchronized and records user-facing mutations in the audit log.
summary: Provides database-backed workspaces that group chats, enforce membership roles, and manage staged collaboration.
